beats.text: A man, maybe 50s: "tall sunflower-like stalks with knobby tubers at the base, found in sunny patches is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

📖 the man in his 50s is walking the person in their 40s, with tattooed arms through the tall sunflower-like stalks with knobby tubers at the base, found in sunny patches — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.

🔥 The fire settles. Tyrone has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikau says quietly "And you're still standing." Nikos says "And you're still standing." Someon
